text: ポケモンに　のって　いくのも　たのしそうだなあ

structure.jp: ポケモンに　のって　いくのも
structure.en: going along riding a Pokémon, too

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (appearance)
patterns.explanation: そう stuck onto a describing word means 'looks like' it, judging by what you see. たのしそうだ = 'it looks fun'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. のって　いくの = 'going along riding'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two actions, and here the first shows the way the second is done. のって　いく = 'go by riding'.
